description: Agent records round 2: check a CDP Bazaar discovery declaration before you publish it. Input declaration: the 402 body with accepts and extensions.bazaar, a route declaration with amount, resource and bazaar (the shape Wever routes declare) or the bazaar extension alone, as JSON, JSON text or the base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, up to 64 KB. The signed report says whether the declaration would pass the validation CDP applies and names every problem: the discovery envelope, info validated against its own schema, schema patterns that are not valid regular expressions or that use lookahead (the (?![\s\S]) strict-end suffix, with the accepted fix: a plain $ anchor with the line terminators excluded beside it), price, asset and network consistency across the payment terms, and input and output schema completeness. It evaluates the supplied declaration only and fetches nothing. POST /api/bazaar-declaration-check. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/reliability/.
